svg.title: Tools in rotation
svg.desc: 20 tools on 4 layers of one stack, pulled apart along a single axis and standing on their layers as brand marks. Bottom to top: tooling (5) Claude Code, MCP, Git, Just, Neovim; cloud (4) AWS, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog; platform (5) Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Docker; languages (6) Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Swift, Shell.
